name: @jasonsdevspace/design-kit
description: Design tokens, also in the Design Tokens Community Group format, base styles, a theme script, and the pieces of the demos on jasonsdevspace.com: page chrome and a site header, a content page, bands, a hero and a group of sections for a landing page, an explainer, buttons and a busy button, fields with marks, read-only fields and a check of the browser's constraints, callouts, tabs, pills, an icon, a theme switch, a copy button and a status line, rows, tiles and an empty state, progress and a loading line, panels and a raised panel, an app's frame, tab bar, toast, grid of buttons, stepper and dialog, and React hooks that attach the controls.
author: Jason Poteet

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/*.css src/tokens.resolver.json dist/
